LanguageData.MFV_MakeArcaneInk.label: make arcane ink
LanguageData.MFV_MakeArcaneInk.description: Steep exotic herbs with gemstone dust into a concentrated ink suitable for magical writing.
LanguageData.MFV_EnchantFlamingLongsword.label: enchant flaming longsword
LanguageData.MFV_EnchantFlamingLongsword.description: Bind a fire arcane focus into a longsword, creating a flaming longsword.
LanguageData.MFV_EnchantZephyrSpear.label: enchant Zephyr Spear
LanguageData.MFV_EnchantZephyrSpear.description: Bind an air arcane focus into a spear, creating Zephyr Spear.
LanguageData.MFV_EnchantTidebreakerMace.label: enchant Tidebreaker Mace
LanguageData.MFV_EnchantTidebreakerMace.description: Bind a water arcane focus into a mace, creating Tidebreaker Mace.
LanguageData.MFV_EnchantStonefallMace.label: enchant Stonefall Mace
LanguageData.MFV_EnchantStonefallMace.description: Bind an earth arcane focus into a mace, creating Stonefall Mace.
LanguageData.MFV_BreakGemstoneChunk.label: break gemstone chunk
LanguageData.MFV_BreakGemstoneChunk.description: Break a rough gemstone chunk into raw pieces.
LanguageData.MFV_BreakDenseGemstoneChunk.label: break dense gemstone chunk
LanguageData.MFV_BreakDenseGemstoneChunk.description: Break a dense gemstone chunk into raw pieces.
LanguageData.MFV_CutGemstone.label: cut gemstone
LanguageData.MFV_CutGemstone.description: Cut and polish a raw gemstone piece into a finished gemstone, collecting more usable gemstone dust when more of the stone is ground away.
LanguageData.MFV_MakeFireArcaneFocus.label: make fire arcane focus
LanguageData.MFV_MakeFireArcaneFocus.description: Set cut rubies into a simple conductive frame to make a fire arcane focus.
LanguageData.MFV_MakeWaterArcaneFocus.label: make water arcane focus
LanguageData.MFV_MakeWaterArcaneFocus.description: Set cut sapphires into a simple conductive frame to make a water arcane focus.
LanguageData.MFV_MakeEarthArcaneFocus.label: make earth arcane focus
LanguageData.MFV_MakeEarthArcaneFocus.description: Set cut emeralds into a simple conductive frame to make an earth arcane focus.
LanguageData.MFV_MakeAirArcaneFocus.label: make air arcane focus
LanguageData.MFV_MakeAirArcaneFocus.description: Set cut topazes into a simple conductive frame to make an air arcane focus.
LanguageData.MFV_MakePapyrus.label: make papyrus
LanguageData.MFV_MakePapyrus.description: Press wood pulp, hay, or other plant fibers into simple papyrus sheets for notes, formulae, and low-order scrollwork.
LanguageData.MFV_MakeParchment.label: make parchment
LanguageData.MFV_MakeParchment.description: Scrape, stretch, and dry leather into durable parchment sheets for formal scrollwork.
LanguageData.MFV_RefineVoidGlass.label: refine void glass
LanguageData.MFV_RefineVoidGlass.description: Cut and stabilize a voidglass chunk into planar glass suitable for construction.
